_comment: Seeded at bootstrap (practice: session-load-budget) so the early-warning notice starts ON. headroom_floor_pct matches BestPractice's own value; each surface's ceiling is measured plus ~20% headroom, the convention every hand-written entry in that repo already uses. .precedent/SESSION_PRACTICES.md is regenerated at every session start and grows with the universal catalogue, so re-measure it when it trips rather than reading the trip as this set growing. A ceiling is a watermark, not an endorsement: review and reduce, never just raise, when it is crossed for real.
_resident_block_comment: This set's resident rules, read by every session of a person who brings it. Carved out of the universal set's 2,000 on 2026-10-02 (BestPractice spec/LADDER_OPT_IN_PLAN.md D15, Morgan, strength: decided), when brainstorm-holds-commits left universal for this set. Measured about 175 that day.

AGENTS.md._note: 1,069 tokens measured 2026-10-02, once the ladder's rules had moved in. 1,300 was carved out of the universal set's AGENTS.md ceiling (7,650 to 6,950; BestPractice spec/LADDER_OPT_IN_PLAN.md D15, Morgan, strength: decided), so no ceiling went up in total. It was 600 at bootstrap, measured on an empty set.

CLAUDE.md._note: 111 tokens measured at bootstrap (2026-10-02). Ceiling is current + ~20%.

.precedent/SESSION_PRACTICES.md._note: 3997 tokens measured at bootstrap (2026-10-02). Ceiling is current + ~20%.
